title: Outcome kinds: no-decision, conditional decision and proof-of-impossibility
question: Implement tools/council/outcomes/kinds.py making NO-DECISION, CONDITIONAL and PROOF-OF-IMPOSSIBILITY first-class, typed outcomes with required fields. Falsifiable question: is any of these three ever coerced into a plain decision by a downstream consumer that only understands PASS/FAIL?
output_schema: command-center/schema/receipt.schema.json profile=council-outcomes-module (required: unit_id, artifact_paths[], spec_anchor, evidence[], test_ids[], negative_control_ids[], reviewer_verdict, residual_unknowns[])

evidence.claim: Every reader of outcome.kind under tools/council/outcomes preserves NO-DECISION, CONDITIONAL and PROOF-OF-IMPOSSIBILITY. Planted PASS/FAIL consumers are classified COERCES.
A fixture of each protected kind flowed ingest->record->synthesize->emit; the final artifact payload is unmodified.
